name: TEGRA
recent: Tegra 于 2026 年 10 月由 Omesti 更名为 Tegra，并在 11 月完成每 5 股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割，合并后股票于 11 月 19 日上市。同期，大股东 Teguh Sedaya 及副董事长 Nur Atisya 持续增持股份，并披露在闭锁期内的交易意向。
notable: 完成每 5 股合并为 1 股的反向股票分割，合并后股票于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市交易。
副董事长 Nur Atisya 通过 Teguh Sedaya 在 10 月 26 日和 11 月 2 日合计增持约 807.7 万股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月由 Omesti Berhad 正式更名为 Tegra Berhad。
risks: 反向股票分割导致已发行股数大幅减少，可能影响股票流通性。
副董事长披露在闭锁期内交易公司证券的意向。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 7 月 31 日）营收为 3112 万令吉，环比下降 16.9%，但同比增长 77.8%；净利润为 616 万令吉，环比增长 114.9%，净利率从 7.6% 提升至 19.8%。

recent_en: Tegra changed its name from Omesti in October 2026 and completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation in November, with consolidated shares listed on 19 November. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Teguh Sedaya and Deputy Chairman Nur Atisya continued to acquire shares and disclosed intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: Completed a 5-into-1 share consolidation, with consolidated shares listed on 19 November 2026.
Deputy Chairman Nur Atisya, via Teguh Sedaya, acquired a total of approximately 8.077 million shares on 26 October and 2 November.
The company officially changed its name from Omesti Berhad to Tegra Berhad in October 2026.
risks_en: The share consolidation significantly reduces the number of issued shares, which may affect trading liquidity.
The Deputy Chairman disclosed an intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For Q3 FY2026 (ended 31 July), revenue was MYR 31.12 million, down 16.9% QoQ but up 77.8% YoY; net income was MYR 6.16 million, up 114.9% QoQ, with net margin improving from 7.6% to 19.8%.
